317-1475-4247.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional modified creature with power 1 or greater.
317-1475-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another modified creature with power one or greater.
When the creature dies, Mazirek and One with the Kami triggers.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Mazirek trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

2738-4871-4976-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Open the Graves, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

277-1308-4094-6753-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-1308-4094-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

254-301-7859.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}
Activate Goblin Chirurgeon by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Goblin Chirurgeon ability.
Repeat from step 2

2146-2781-5998-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

4478-6006-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4478-6006-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4478-6006-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

3240-5147-6351-6462.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Teval triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2757-3525-3711.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Moonfolk Puzzlemaker.
Moonfolk Puzzlemaker triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Moonfolk Puzzlemaker.
Repeat.

856-4050-5776-7396.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

6797-6887-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
6797-6887-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, The Skullspore Nexus and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

632-3621-4659-5129-7292.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-3621-4659-5129-7292.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

2099-3621-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.
2099-3621-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can just do step 1 repeatedly.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

1308-2034-2762.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1170-1177-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Narset by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to look at the top four cards of your library, then reveal Sensei's Divining Top and put it into your hand.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}
Displacer Kitten and Birgi trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Narset.
Repeat.

1050-7078.description:
Activate Nevinyrral's Disk by paying {1} and tapping it, destroying all artifacts, creatures and enchantments. Your noncreature artifacts, including Nevinyrral's Disk, will not be destroyed, as they have indestructible due to Guardian Beast.
Repeat during each of your turns.
1050-7078.notes: It is strongly recommended to give Guardian Beast indestructible so it will not be destroyed, and this loop can be repeated during subsequent turns. If you do not give it indestructible, you can only do this loop twice unless you recur it.

1409-1671-2895-6664.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1409-1671-2895-6664.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

1099-2173-4740-5220.manaNeeded: {3}{B} if Sling-Gang Lieutenant is in your hand
1099-2173-4740-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 5 if Sling-Gang Lieutenant is on top of your library.
1099-2173-4740-5220.description:
Cast Sling-Gang Lieutenant either from the top of your library by paying 4 life or from your hand by paying {3}{B}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
When Sling-Gang Lieutenant enters, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant three times by sacrificing the Goblin tokens and then Sling-Gang Lieutenant.
When Sling-Gang Lieutenant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Sling-Gang Lieutenant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve all Sling-Gang Lieutenant abilities, causing target opponent to lose 3 life and you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

997-3234-3293-5226.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
997-3234-3293-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat
997-3234-3293-5226.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

826-1399-1606-4249.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 4.
826-1399-1606-4249.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to your devotion to green.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

2957-4508-5880-6753.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it,, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

573-5451-5478-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
573-5451-5478-5702.description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters untapped due to Spelunking, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

1274-2086-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1069-3499-5285-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
1069-3499-5285-5499.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Angel.
Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Angels.

116-151-5261.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Kiora's Follower does not have summoning sickness.
116-151-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets near-infinite mana.

643-3168-4770-5613.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

369-2730-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake
Repeat.

1409-2288-4050-4150-4823.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Timeless Witness.
1409-2288-4050-4150-4823.description:
Cast Shivan Meteor by paying {3}{R}{R}, dealing 13 damage to Tangled Colony.
Tangled Colony dies as a state-based action due to having less than 0 toughness.
Tangled Colony triggers, creating thirteen 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar eleven times by sacrificing eleven Rats, adding {6}{U}{U}{B}{R}{R}.
Activate Timeless Witness by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Timeless Witness.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Tangled Colony to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 5 one additional time, returning Shivan Meteor to your hand using Timeless Witness instead.
Cast Tangled Colony by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

413-1150-2018.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Melira's Keepers.
When Melira's Keepers dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Melira's Keepers from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Melira's Keepers' ability.
When Melira's Keepers enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1703-2880-3783-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control another Illusion with power five or greater.
1703-2880-3783-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another Illusion with power five or greater.
The Illusion dies, triggering Minn's second ability, putting Fool's Demise from your hand onto the battlefield attached to Phantasmal Dreadmaw.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Phantasmal Dreadmaw.
Phantasmal Dreadmaw dies, triggering Minn's second ability and Fool's Demise's first and second abilities.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Phantasmal Dreadmaw from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Minn trigger, putting Fool's Demise from your hand onto the battlefield attached to Phantasmal Dreadmaw.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 4, Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Phantasmal Dreadmaw's power.
Repeat from step 4.

262-1636.notablePrerequisites: Elemental Mastery attached to any creature you control without summoning sickness that has power one or greater.
262-1636.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to the creatures power.
The Elementals enter the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm that many times.
Resolve each Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

4944-5057.description:
Activate Jodah's Avenger's ability.
Hold priority and repeat this an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the Crackdown Construct triggers, making Crackdown Construct arbitrarily large.

618-1267-3745.notablePrerequisites:
Identity Thief does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block Medomai token.
618-1267-3745.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a copy of Identity Thief with haste.
Attack with the Identity Thief token, triggering it and exiling Medomai the Ageless until end of turn.
the Identity Thief token will deal combat damage as a copy of Medomai the Ageless, granting you an extra turn.
At the end of the turn, Medomai the Ageless returns to the battlefield.
Sacrifice the token.
Repeat for infinite turns.

586-3249-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {B}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Priest of Gix from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Priest of Gix from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
